title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. My name is mohammed zaheer uddinansari, iam from toronto , canada 1)we have a big masjid in markham ( toronto ) canada . We pray isha salat behind one imam after that we run 2 taraweeh in two different halls, one in main masjid another one in parallel multi purpose hall. In main masjid traweeh, we complete quran in 27 days & in other hall we complete quran in 10 days. The main purpose was to bring every one to masjid including those who were doing traweeh in jamat in houses and or in other than masjid halls. Can we do it ? 2) few huffaz does not have long enough beard(less than a musht), last year they promised they will not trim after ramadhan but they did. This year they regretted of trimming their beard & promised management they will not do it again. Can they lead the traweeh ? Since traweeh may start tonight we request the rulling urgently, please help. 1864 views Q. When to end the fast 2161 views Q. As salam Alaekum, My father is diabetic and he is on medication,recently his blood sugar level are very high and still not in control,he keeps all the fasts of ramzan,during the fasts there chances that his blood sugar level may go down the normal value,for that purpose during Roza is it allowed to check his blood sugar level with Accu Chek(A Procedure in which the finger is pierced with a needle and a drop of blood comes out and that drop has to be put on machine for testing) or that will cause any harm to his roza. I have met with many doctors (MBBS / good practitioner) , all of them have prescribed me not to be empty stomach for more than 2 Hours. Now please tell me that should i have fast (Roza)in the month of Ramzaan or can i leave it? or please tell me any solution to have fast(Roza) in coming Ramadhaan and acid /Gastric is also not produced. Jazakallah... 2437 views Q. Spraying nasal spray into nose while fasting 13896 views Q. Janab, ?ASSALAMU ALAIKUM? In connection with the Ramzan donation towards the expenditure of ?IFTHAAR? occasion in the Aminjikarai Mosque, Chennai, I would like to clarify the following query as per the shariath at the earliest possible. 1. Whether the balance amount of Kanzi donation can be utilized for the purchase of Boondi, electrical (light) decoration of mosque on the occasion of ?Lilathul Qadir night? (27th Day of Ramzan). 2. Whether the same amount can be utilized for the purchase of cloths for the staff of the mosque i.e., Imam, Mouzin, Makondar, Administrative staff & watchmen. 3. It is to state that our Mouzin took much effort to collect the donation from various persons of our mohalla. Previously, we paid the amount from the collection amount. Now the present secretary of Aminjikarai mosque made an objection to this and also to stop the collection of donation through Mouzin. Is it correct as per shariath. 1512 views Q. I am pregnant and my due date is 13th june. Ramadan fasts are starting from august. My child will be too small and will depend on my breast milk. Is it compulsory for me to fast during those days, can I keep these fasts later. 4119 views Q. answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 2486 Country: ZA Title: Is it permissible to take vitamin injections while fasting? Question: Is it permissible to take vitamin injections while fasting? Answer ID: 2486 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1296/1157=B) Yes, it is right, but not desirable. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
